verdict.rationale: Governing AI agents per group or instance is a fair question for a code-hosting platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no evidence that Gitea can enable or disable AI agents per organization or instance, or set allow/ask/deny policies for agent tools. General user permissions, ACLs, admin configuration and the existence of an official MCP server are adjacent features, not this capability.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can enable or disable AI agents per group or instance and set allow, ask, or deny policies for the tools they can use
